mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in two months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST drops > 10% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in two months signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% in two months, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases > 1% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY, it signals a tightening monetary policy with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with weak growth
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the GDP (GDPC1) growth is above 3% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals strong economic fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 YoY > 3% and UNRATE < 4%.
